gaps.explanation: Statement p5 General Fund prints transfers gross: Transfers in 370,874, Transfers out (51,593), Net transfers 319,281 (Total Governmental Funds transfers in 795,349). The Combining Statement - General Fund Departments (pp21-22) prints only one net 'Transfer in (out)' per department: Administration 13,854, Clerk 50,653, Zoning 26,332, Police 75,192, Fire 22,488, Ambulance 17,607, Cemetery 24,143, Park 28,761, Pool 26,705, Library 33,546 = 319,281 (= the statement's General Fund net). So the General Fund's gross transfers in 370,874 - 319,281 = 51,593 are netted against its 51,593 transfers out inside the department figures; the schedule does not print which department paid the 51,593 out. Other funds agree with the statement (Street 76,689, Economic Development 137,362, Grant 68,894, Lottery 60,000, Capital Projects 81,530). Schedule 743,756 + 51,593 = 795,349. Printed net-by-department presentation; no line can be added without inventing a split.

Statement p5 transfers out 475,433 = General Fund (51,593) + Sales Tax Fund (421,478) + Grant Fund (2,362). Detail has Sales Tax (421,478) p16 and Grant (2,362) p19 = 423,840; the General Fund's (51,593) is netted inside the per-department 'Transfer in (out)' amounts of the General Fund Departments schedule (pp21-22), all of which are net inflows totalling 319,281 = statement GF net transfers (370,874 - 51,593). Same 51,593 as the transfers_in gap; printed net-by-department presentation, no fix.
